claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (MMV/PSV/AutoFlow, PEEP 5, FiO2 40%) and monitor ventilator parameters and alarms.
Monitor arterial blood pressure and titrate vasoactive medications (nicardipine, labetalol, metoprolol, hydralazine) to maintain mean arterial pressure above 60 mmHg.
Monitor intracranial pressure and cerebral perfusion pressure, keeping ICP <20 mmHg and CPP >60 mmHg.
Replace potassium chloride orally to correct hypokalemia (K 3.4 mEq/L) and recheck serum potassium.
Monitor ionized calcium and consider calcium replacement for hypocalcemia (ionized Ca 1.06 mmol/L).
Perform regular subglottal suctioning and maintain ventilator circuit to prevent ventilator-associated complications.
Reposition patient regularly and use pressure-relieving measures due to Braden score indicating high risk for pressure ulcers.
Provide eye care to prevent corneal abrasions in sedated patient.
Monitor blood glucose via fingerstick and treat hyperglycemia as needed.
Maintain sedation with propofol and/or lorazepam to achieve goal RASS 0 (alert and calm) while monitoring sedation level.
